nodes.description: Public string state variable storing the token symbol 'INFC'.
Public string state variable storing the token name 'InfiniCoin'.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals (2).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply (2100000).
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of each holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Public address state variable holding the contract owner in Owned.
Public address state variable holding the pending new owner in the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and checks overflow via division.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
InfiniCoin constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints all tokens to a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns the balance of the given owner.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens using the caller's allowance, updating balances and allowed mappings.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Fallback payable function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token contract.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages the ownership transfer.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): pending new owner accepts ownership, updates owner and clears newOwner.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for balance updates, allowance keys and ownership checks.
Addition 'c = a + b' inside safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a).
Subtraction 'c = a - b' inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication 'c = a * b' inside safeMul guarded by the division overflow check.
Division 'c = a / b' inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-supplied contract with no return check.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with an arbitrary token address and unchecked return value.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) implemented in the onlyOwner modifier.
